nodes.label: Original six analytic callers and finite real Hilbert/Borel carrier
nodes.meaning: Six source standing assumptions retained; dimension may be0 and alpha*eta=1.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: SAME actual center and residual gradient
nodes.meaning: c=y-eta gradV(xRef); h(x)=gradV(x)-gradV(xRef).
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: SAME actual harmonic flow
nodes.meaning: Exact two-component flow for all real times, joint continuity; future reuse of actual73 is a proof edge, not a public parameter.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: SAME actual residual bounce rate
nodes.meaning: sqrt(eta)*max(inner(p,h(x)),0); nonnegative, jointly continuous; zero residual gives zero instantaneous rate.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Actual bounce with R0=I
nodes.meaning: No refresh event; discontinuous S at zero normal is allowed; this is not a continuity premise for clock.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: SAME weighted SUM harmonic energy
nodes.meaning: H=((1/eta)*norm(x-c)^2+norm(p)^2)/2>=0; not product norm or arbitrary supplied energy.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Actual flow conserves H
nodes.meaning: One deterministic orbit conserves its starting energy; this alone is not global random-path conservation.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Exact cap on a SAME energy layer
nodes.meaning: C_E=sqrt(eta)*beta*sqrt(2E)*(sqrt(2eta E)+norm(c-xRef)); no unknown multiplicative constant.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Actual hazard integrand
nodes.meaning: q(a,s)=lambda_xRef(Phi_s^(y,xRef)(z)); joint continuous/nonnegative from actual producers.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Finite-interval integrability and joint primitive
nodes.meaning: Lambda(a,t)=integral_0^t q(a,s) ds on nonnegative time; joint continuous/Borel and real finite at every finite t.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Zero/nonnegative/nondecreasing hazard
nodes.meaning: Lambda(a,0)=0; 0<=Lambda(a,t); monotone only in nonnegative time.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Extended nonnegative clock and threshold
nodes.meaning: e:NNReal (or equivalent real e>=0); tau in WithTop NNReal; inf empty=top through explicit branch.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Closed nonempty threshold set has least crossing
nodes.meaning: {u>=0:e<=Lambda(a,u)} closed and bounded below; no WellFoundedLT/discrete-time reasoning.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Clock infinity/attainment/zero/positivity laws
nodes.meaning: tau=top iff crossing set empty; finite tau gives Lambda(tau)=e; e=0 gives tau=0; e>0 implies tau>0 including infinity.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Exact finite-time threshold equivalence
nodes.meaning: tau(a,e)<=t iff e<=Lambda(a,t) for t>=0; use attained infimum and monotonicity.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Joint Borel clock
nodes.meaning: Finite sublevels equal closed/measurable threshold preimages; top sublevel is all. No joint clock continuity assertion.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Actual starting-energy cap along one flow segment
nodes.meaning: C(a)=C_(H(a,z)); H(Phi_s z)=H(z) supplies the exact74 energy-layer cap internally.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Actual integrated hazard cap
nodes.meaning: Lambda(a,t)<=C(a)*t, finite nonnegative C(a), all finite nonnegative times.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Extended wait lower bound and zero-cap branch
nodes.meaning: If C>0, (e/C:WithTop NNReal)<=tau; if C=0 and e>0, tau=top. e=0 still gives0.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Actual Exp(1) threshold marginal
nodes.meaning: Canonical fixed law expMeasure(1); not arbitrary probability space/rv premise. Independent sequence excluded at this one-clock stage.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Real Exp support and threshold carrier transport
nodes.meaning: Use rate1 CDF internally: e>=0 a.s., e=0 mass0; real.toNNReal collapse of negative null set preserves threshold law.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: One-clock pushforward probability law
nodes.meaning: map (e |-> tau(a,Real.toNNReal(e))) (expMeasure1 in descriptive notation); use actual declaration expMeasure(1).
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Exact one-clock survival law
nodes.meaning: P(tau>t)=exp(-Lambda(a,t)); ENNReal.ofReal if expressed as measure, or explicit toReal probability convention.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Degenerate branches remain legal
nodes.meaning: Rank0 and H=0 imply zero-rate orbit; e>0 waits infinity and e=0 waits0. C>0 never licenses finite tau without crossing.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Actual A.1 clock substituted at postjump state
nodes.meaning: Selected single-clock laws are consumed at actual zeta_Tn and E_(n+1); production of those states is not supplied here.
nodes.status: OPEN consumer

nodes.label: A.2 measurable event/path recursion
nodes.meaning: Finite/empty branch, between-jump path, initial draws and actual postbounce states remain open.
nodes.status: OPEN consumer

nodes.label: Global initial-energy cap across stochastic recursion
nodes.meaning: Requires actual path recursion and bounce plus flow energy conservation, not just an arbitrary r/state cap.
nodes.status: OPEN consumer

nodes.label: iid Exp sum/nonexplosion and wellposed process
nodes.meaning: Requires product clocks, support/moment/SLLN and path construction; no current proof credit.
nodes.status: OPEN consumer

nodes.label: Memorylessness/time-homogeneous Markov property
nodes.meaning: Measurable recursive construction and exponential memorylessness are still distinct obligations.
nodes.status: OPEN consumer

nodes.label: Stationarity/reversal/semigroup/terminal/main/cost
nodes.meaning: All excluded from selected single-clock mathematics; Davis bibliography is attribution, not inspected theorem evidence.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: beta-Lipschitz/continuous gradient internally produced
nodes.meaning: C2 plus Hessian upper bound gives gradient beta-Lipschitz; no new regularity/integrability premise.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

nodes.label: Algorithm1 has no refresh clock
nodes.meaning: Initial Gaussian momentum/reference draws are not ongoing refresh. No refresh intensity enters Lambda or tau.
nodes.status: SOURCE projection / obligation only; no75 theorem credit

topology_scope: One actual fixed-reference integrated-hazard first clock and its explicit open A.1/A.2 consumers; source evidence and ASTIS internal bridges typed separately.
